4 · Every badge state at 2x (tab bar crop, 100x64 at 1x)
Geometry at 1x, inside .ph-tab-icon (64 x 32): height 18, padding 0 5px, font 12/18 700, min-width 18, radius 9, top -2px.
Left edge fixed at icon centre + 4px (left: calc(50% + 4px)), so the badge grows right into the empty slot. Today it is right: 6px and grows left over the icon.
Fill bgColor-accent-emphasis, text fgColor-onEmphasis, ring 0 0 0 2px bgColor-inset (all web/tokens.css). Unchanged from today's .ph-count.
Dot: 8 x 8, radius 4, top 0, same left edge, fill and ring. The badge and dot are aria-hidden; the tab button carries the name.
Shape carries state: a number, a dot or nothing. Colour never carries it alone. Labels are 13px here; see the label fix in the spec.
